_about: The world's listed companies by market value (companiesmarketcap.com, 2026-11-18), the private companies valued at $1 billion or more (CB Insights' unicorn list) and the largest unlisted companies by revenue (Wikipedia's lists). status: listed, startup (a unicorn) or private (state-owned or private, revenue in US$). A listed company's moment (date, time, tz_east, place) is its first listing's first trading day (listed, exchange) at the exchange, timed at the exchange's opening: the minute of the first trade is seldom recorded, so time_confidence is approx (reported where a Rodden AA or A chart of the first trade gives it). The day comes from the exchange's own list (NSE, TWSE, KRX, SSE, SZSE), else Wikidata's start time of the listing, else Yahoo Finance's first trading day where it agrees with those for that exchange and era (on the US markets before Wikidata, and the market named is Yahoo's today). listings: every listing known [exchange, ticker, day or year, source, ended]. A company with no listing day, and every unlisted one, is cast for its founding day at local noon (time_confidence date) when Wikidata gives the day; founded is YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD as precise as known, and a startup without one is still listed. Biography: Yahoo Finance's profile, Wikidata, Wikipedia's index tables. Built by tools/mundane_finance.py; data/mundane/FINANCE.md has the checks.
